description: MLIT provides regional transport flows for 2001 to 2018 from its freight and passenger flow surveys. Passenger totals connect 51 regions by mode, while freight totals connect 54 regions by mode and nine commodity groups. Lines between representative regional locations carry the flow attributes. Passenger fields include rail, bus, passenger ship and aviation; freight fields distinguish rail, shipping and road transport. These aggregates support regional transport-demand and logistics models. The source warns that small regional or commodity subdivisions of the sampled road-freight statistics have low precision and recommends aggregation or averaging across years. Private-bus and private-car passenger categories were removed from the 2010 survey onward, which limits comparisons across that boundary. The provider supplies GML and Shapefile metadata and download links, with GeoJSON available from 2016. Access is free under the National Land Numerical Information terms; the page permits commercial use. Only the catalogue metadata was reviewed. Dataset files and their current contents were not downloaded. The related parent record is the MLIT National Land Numerical Information catalogue.
